<mxfile host="Electron" agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) draw.io/29.5.1 Chrome/142.0.7444.265 Electron/39.6.1 Safari/537.36" version="29.5.1"> <diagram id="stacksaga-pausable-lrt-lifecycle" name="pausable-lrt-lifecycle-vertical"> <mxGraphModel dx="840" dy="675" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="840" pageHeight="675" background="#FFFFFF" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" />
<!-- Master Title --> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=6;fillColor=#F8FAFC;strokeColor=#E2E8F0;strokeWidth=1.2;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="<b style='font-size:15px;color:#0F172A;'>Real-World Saga Flow: Continuous &amp; Pausable Orchestration</b><br/><span style='font-size:11px;color:#475569;'>Order-service coordinates unbroken local steps (.noPause) and asynchronous wait-states (.pause)</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="46" width="790" x="25" y="12" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Left Column: Order-service Container --> <mxCell id="orch_container" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=4;fillColor=#F8FAFC;strokeColor=#94A3B8;strokeWidth=2;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=16;spacingTop=10;" value="<b style='font-size:14px;color:#1E293B;'>Order-service (Saga Orchestrator Application)</b>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="585" width="410" x="25" y="68" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Right Column Header --> <mxCell id="ext_header" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=4;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#93C5FD;strokeWidth=1.5;verticalAlign=middle;align=center;" value="<b style='font-size:13.5px;color:#1E3A8A;'>Target Microservices &amp; External Systems</b>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="34" width="330" x="485" y="68" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- [1] exe-1 --> <mxCell id="exe1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=8;fillColor=#DCFCE7;strokeColor=#16A34A;strokeWidth=1.5;align=center;" value="<b style='font-size:12.5px;color:#15803D;'>exe-1 (no pause)</b><br/><span style='font-size:11px;color:#166534;'>CheckCustomerEligibility (QueryExecutor)</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="355" x="50" y="112" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b1" parent="1" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#16A34A;strokeColor=#FFFFFF;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=10;" value="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="20" x="42" y="104" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- [2] exe-2 --> <mxCell id="exe2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=8;fillColor=#DCFCE7;strokeColor=#16A34A;strokeWidth=1.5;align=center;" value="<b style='font-size:12.5px;color:#15803D;'>exe-2 (no pause)</b><br/><span style='font-size:11px;color:#166534;'>CreateOrder (CommandExecutor)</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="355" x="50" y="192" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b2" parent="1" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#16A34A;strokeColor=#FFFFFF;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=10;" value="2" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="20" x="42" y="184" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- [3] exe-3 --> <mxCell id="exe3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=8;fillColor=#F5F3FF;strokeColor=#7C3AED;strokeWidth=1.8;align=center;" value="<b style='font-size:12.5px;color:#6D28D9;'>exe-3 (pause)</b><br/><span style='font-size:11px;color:#7C3AED;'>ProcessPayment (CommandExecutor)</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="355" x="50" y="272" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b3" parent="1" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#7C3AED;strokeColor=#FFFFFF;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=10;" value="3" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="20" x="42" y="264" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Wait state indicator 1 --> <mxCell id="wait1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=50;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F8FAFC;strokeColor=#CBD5E1;strokeWidth=1;strokeDashed=1;fontSize=9.5;fontColor=#64748B;fontStyle=2;align=center;" value="Thread Released · Awaiting Callback" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="18" width="210" x="125" y="334" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- [4] /resume-to 4 (Boundary Aligned) --> <mxCell id="resume4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FEF3C7;strokeColor=#D97706;strokeWidth=1.8;align=center;" value="<b style='font-size:11.5px;color:#92400E;'>Webhook: /resume-to 4</b><br/><span style='font-family:monospace;font-size:9.5px;color:#B45309;'>sagaTemplate.resume(txId, key)</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="235" x="195" y="362" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b4" parent="1" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#D97706;strokeColor=#FFFFFF;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=10;" value="4" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="20" x="185" y="352" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- [5] exe-4 --> <mxCell id="exe4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=8;fillColor=#F5F3FF;strokeColor=#7C3AED;strokeWidth=1.8;align=center;" value="<b style='font-size:12.5px;color:#6D28D9;'>exe-4 (pause)</b><br/><span style='font-size:11px;color:#7C3AED;'>DispatchDelivery (CommandExecutor)</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="355" x="50" y="426" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b5" parent="1" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#7C3AED;strokeColor=#FFFFFF;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=10;" value="5" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="20" x="42" y="418" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Wait state indicator 2 --> <mxCell id="wait2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=50;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F8FAFC;strokeColor=#CBD5E1;strokeWidth=1;strokeDashed=1;fontSize=9.5;fontColor=#64748B;fontStyle=2;align=center;" value="Thread Released · Awaiting Callback" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="18" width="210" x="125" y="488" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- [6] /resume-to 5 (Boundary Aligned) --> <mxCell id="resume5" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FEF3C7;strokeColor=#D97706;strokeWidth=1.8;align=center;" value="<b style='font-size:11.5px;color:#92400E;'>Webhook: /resume-to 5</b><br/><span style='font-family:monospace;font-size:9.5px;color:#B45309;'>sagaTemplate.resume(txId, key)</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="235" x="195" y="516" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b6" parent="1" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#D97706;strokeColor=#FFFFFF;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=10;" value="6" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="20" x="185" y="506" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- [7] exe-5 --> <mxCell id="exe5" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=8;fillColor=#ECFDF5;strokeColor=#059669;strokeWidth=2;align=center;" value="<b style='font-size:12.5px;color:#047857;'>exe-5 (complete)</b><br/><span style='font-size:11px;color:#065F46;'>FinalizeOrder (no pause - terminal step)</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="355" x="50" y="580" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b7" parent="1" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#059669;strokeColor=#FFFFFF;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=10;" value="7" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="20" x="42" y="572" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Target Services (Right Column) --> <mxCell id="srv1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=6;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#3B82F6;strokeWidth=1.2;align=center;" value="<b style='font-size:12.5px;color:#1E3A8A;'>service-1</b><br/><span style='font-size:11px;color:#2563EB;'>User Service (REST / Feign)</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="330" x="485" y="112" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="srv2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=6;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#3B82F6;strokeWidth=1.2;align=center;" value="<b style='font-size:12.5px;color:#1E3A8A;'>service-2</b><br/><span style='font-size:11px;color:#2563EB;'>Order DB (Local JPA / PostgreSQL)</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="330" x="485" y="192" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="srv3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=6;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#3B82F6;strokeWidth=1.2;align=center;" value="<b style='font-size:12.5px;color:#1E3A8A;'>service-3</b><br/><span style='font-size:11px;color:#2563EB;'>Payment Gateway (Stripe / Bank API)</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="330" x="485" y="272" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="srv4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=6;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#3B82F6;strokeWidth=1.2;align=center;" value="<b style='font-size:12.5px;color:#1E3A8A;'>service-4</b><br/><span style='font-size:11px;color:#2563EB;'>Delivery Partner Service (Logistics API)</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="330" x="485" y="426" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Vertical Connectors inside Orchestrator --> <mxCell id="v_1_2" edge="1" parent="1" source="exe1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#16A34A;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;" target="exe2" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="v_2_3" edge="1" parent="1" source="exe2" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#16A34A;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;" target="exe3" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="v_r4_4" edge="1" parent="1" source="resume4" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#7C3AED;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;" target="exe4" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="v_r5_5" edge="1" parent="1" source="resume5" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#16A34A;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;" target="exe5" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Horizontal Calls (Left -> Right) --> <mxCell id="h_call1" edge="1" parent="1" source="exe1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#16A34A;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;" target="srv1" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="h_call2" edge="1" parent="1" source="exe2" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#16A34A;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;" target="srv2" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="h_call3" edge="1" parent="1" source="exe3" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#7C3AED;strokeWidth=2.2;endArrow=classic;" target="srv3" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="h_call4" edge="1" parent="1" source="exe4" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#7C3AED;strokeWidth=2.2;endArrow=classic;" target="srv4" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Webhook Return Connectors (Right -> Left, Dashed Amber) --> <mxCell id="wbk3" edge="1" parent="1" source="srv3" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#D97706;strokeWidth=2;strokeDashed=1;endArrow=classic;fontSize=10;fontColor=#B45309;fontStyle=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=1;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;dashed=1;" target="resume4" value="Async Webhook"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="wbk4" edge="1" parent="1" source="srv4" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#D97706;strokeWidth=2;strokeDashed=1;endArrow=classic;fontSize=10;fontColor=#B45309;fontStyle=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=1;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;dashed=1;" target="resume5" value="Async Webhook"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
svg.style: background-color: #ffffff; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;

g.text: Real-World Saga Flow: Continuous & Pausable Orchestration
Order-service coordinates unbroken local steps (.noPause) and asynchronous wait-states (.pause)
